content_zh: “布展工”是制作、安置与维护展品的人。也是一切在创造性劳动中接触物质，使用技术，反观自身，并通过展示共享使知识重新得到生产与分配的人。
“布展工EXHIBITECHS” 想要发展为一个以技术为锚点的跨学科知识项目，通过研究、写作、策划和设计，尝试连接自然科学、工程制造、人文艺术等不同领域中的实践者，探索材料、工艺与人之间的隐藏关联，模糊物质性生产与非物质性生产的界限，对当下的劳动图景和生活形态展开新的想象。
微信公众号：布展工EXHIBITECHS
content_en: '布展工' (Technicians) are the fabricators, installers and maintainers of exhibits. It also refers to those who involve material and technology for creative practice, as well as reproduce and redistribute knowledge through showcasing and sharing.

'布展工EXHIBITECHS' expects to evolve as an interdisciplinary knowledging project, gathering research, writing, curating and design hinged around technology. It seeks to connect practitioners across diverse fields such as science, engineering, art and humanity, to envision potential landscape of labour and life by exploring hidden links among materials, workmanship and people, and bluring the boundry between material and immaterial production.
